import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_native = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [85.5, 92.3, 78.1]
})
df_native["score"] = df_native["score"].astype("float64")

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_native)

# Convert columns: user_id to Int32, score to Float32
df_converted = df.with_columns([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32),
])

# Display result
result = df_converted.to_native()
print(result)
print(result.dtypes)
